description: A pinned origin is listed with kind origin, pinned true, its identity the pin (checked against the stored tree), and its origin as the manifest declares it. Every digest in the pinned line is the documented sha256sum recipe's, computed without kdlith: a tree's identity is its canonical tree digest, the local source's the same canonical form over the documents the reading read from it (by shown path), and the fingerprint the sha256 of one `NAME IDENTITY` line per named source used, in name order
